# Ryan L'Italien

> Fractional CTO and forward deployed engineer for companies whose growth runs through partners, integrations, and AI. 20+ years shipping production code, startups to Fortune 100. Founder of ButterStack (game-studio SaaS) and the Simple viewer apps for macOS.
